title: Studio: a person's Save on a permission set, hook, added action or OWD row publishes a pending AI draft of that item with no notice (the AI notice and its discard exist only on objects and flows)
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZeHNsF3RWcWpj7rGj

Source: fleet-filed by this seat after PR #36652 (#36511, PR 3 of 3) merged. Raised by the contract review on that PR (records 7096256689 and 7096452455, both as a note) and by the #36511 card thread. Not a regression: #36652 shipped item 6 for objects and flows only, as its body says.

Suggested-type: Feature (it extends an existing notice to more editors; the maintainer's pick list decides whether and when)
Suggested-grade: p2
Suggested-domain: `domain:ui`
Suggested-area: `area:build`

## What happens today (main after #36652)

- Since epic #36510 (「人改一项、点保存、立刻生效。草稿加整包发布只留给 AI」), a person's Save in Studio writes the item and publishes it at once.
- On an **object** or a **flow** with the AI's unpublished draft, the page opens on the AI's version and shows 「这一项有 AI 未发布的改动，保存会一并生效」 with 「放弃 AI 的改动」 (`StudioDesignSurface.tsx`, `StudioAiDraftNotice.tsx`).
- On a **permission set**, a **hook**, an installed app's **added action**, or an **OWD row**, there is no such line. If the AI left a draft of that item, the person's Save publishes it together with their own edit, and nothing on the page says so.

## Why it matters

The person believes they are publishing their one change. On a permission set, the AI's part can be a grant change. On a hook, it can be server-side behaviour. Both then go live under the person's Save.

## Ask (for the maintainer's pick)

Show the same notice and per-item discard on these editors, using the same rules as objects and flows:
- the line only for an AI-written draft (`by` is copilot or mcp), never for a person's own draft;
- the discard asks first when the page has unsaved edits;
- the discard drops that one item's draft at its package (`DELETE /meta/:type/:name?state=draft&package=`), never the package batch.

## Not in scope

- The per-item discard on a never-published AI item removes the item, while its title says "go back to the live version". That is a wording note for the same follow-up, if picked.
